BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Pinsly Railroad Company is a U.S. short-line freight-rail and logistics platform operating nine railroads across ten states. The business provides freight transportation, transload, railcar storage, industrial-development, warehousing and related logistics services to customers in agriculture, chemicals, fuels, plastics, building materials, lumber and metals. Macquarie Infrastructure Partners V acquired 100% of predecessor RailUSA in 2022. The platform later operated as Gulf & Atlantic Railways, acquired the legacy Pinsly railroad and logistics businesses in 2023, and adopted the Pinsly name in 2024. The operating railroads and logistics subsidiaries are components of this single manager-level platform.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Treaty Oak Clean Energy, LLC is a U.S. utility-scale renewable-power platform that develops, finances, constructs, owns and operates solar and battery-storage projects, with wind development capabilities added through Galehead. Current company materials describe a portfolio exceeding 15 GW, including 485 MW in construction or operation. Macquarie Asset Management acquired the platform in 2022 and now holds it through the Macquarie Green Energy and Climate Opportunities Fund. Galehead became a wholly owned subsidiary in 2025 and remains inside this single manager-level platform.

STORY TIMELINE
Feb 24, 2025
Acquisition

Macquarie acquired the remaining controlling interests in Galehead Development and integrated Galehead as a wholly owned Treaty Oak subsidiary.

Apr 17, 2024
Financing

Macquarie announced that its Green Energy and Climate Opportunities Fund acquired Treaty Oak from Macquarie's balance sheet.

Dec 19, 2022
Investment

Macquarie Asset Management's Green Investment Group announced the acquisition of Treaty Oak Clean Energy.

api.description: Maverick 6 & 7 is a shared California renewable-power portfolio comprising the Maverick 6 solar-plus-storage project and the Maverick 7 solar project in Riverside County. Maverick 6 includes 100 MWac of solar generation and a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery system, while Maverick 7 provides 132 MWac of solar generation. Munich Re, through a MEAG-managed MR Falcon vehicle, owns 50% of each project and EDF Renewables retains the other 50%. The projects operate within CAISO and supply contracted renewable power; their project LLCs are treated as underlying assets rather than separate portfolio companies.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Maverick 6 & 7 is a shared California renewable-power portfolio comprising the Maverick 6 solar-plus-storage project and the Maverick 7 solar project in Riverside County.

Maverick 6 includes 100 MWac of solar generation and a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery system, while Maverick 7 provides 132 MWac of solar generation. Munich Re, through a MEAG-managed MR Falcon vehicle, owns 50% of each project and EDF Renewables retains the other 50%. The projects operate within CAISO and supply contracted renewable power; their project LLCs are treated as underlying assets rather than separate portfolio companies.

STORY TIMELINE
Aug 17, 2022
Expansion

EDF Renewables announced that Maverick 6 was fully operational, including its solar generation and battery-storage system.

Jan 18, 2022
Financing

MR Falcon closed the acquisition of the Maverick 67 holdco interests, giving Munich Re 50% of each project alongside EDF Renewables.

Sep 14, 2021
Financing

EDF Renewables and MEAG announced Munich Re's agreement to acquire a 50% interest in the Maverick 6 and Maverick 7 projects.

Dec 20, 2019

CleanPowerSF entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 100 MWac of Maverick 6 solar capacity.
